articles.title: Olivia Chow paints a picture of two different Torontos in re-election campaign bid

articles.title: Family members of Toronto filmmaker describe their pain at hearing for couple found guilty in his death
articles.summary: Family members of a filmmaker found dead in a condo trash compactor in Liberty Village described their grief and anguish at a sentencing hearing Wednesday for the couple found guilty in his death.

articles.title: North York flower farm destroyed by last week’s storm
articles.summary: A severe storm that swept through the Greater Toronto Area last week, left behind a trail of destruction, including heavy damage to a local flower farmer in North York. articles.title: Mississauga comedy festival with headliner John Mulaney postponed days before event
articles.summary: Organizers of the Great Outdoors Comedy Festival say its cavalcade of laughs set for this weekend in Mississauga, Ont., has been postponed.

articles.title: Motorcyclist dead after collision in Scarborough: police
articles.summary: A man in his 20s is dead after a motorcycle crash in Scarborough Tuesday afternoon, police said.
